purpose: Keep provider access, downstream data rights, branding permission, and formal relationship status separate and fail closed.

rightDimensions.label: API/service access
rightDimensions.description: Permission to access the provider API/service under the identified plan/terms.

rightDimensions.label: Processing/derived use
rightDimensions.description: Permission to analyze, transform, derive metrics/findings, or otherwise process provider output.

rightDimensions.label: Cache/storage
rightDimensions.description: Permission to retain provider output or necessary evidence, including retention scope where known.

rightDimensions.label: Redistribution/export
rightDimensions.description: Permission to deliver raw or selected provider values and/or derived output to customers, including PDF/JSON exports.

rightDimensions.label: Commercial use
rightDimensions.description: Permission to use the provider in a paid/commercial Velmere product.

rightDimensions.label: Logo/trademark
rightDimensions.description: Permission to display provider name/logo/marks in the specifically described context.

rightDimensions.label: Formal partnership
rightDimensions.description: Executed or mutually accepted formal partner/collaboration status; ordinary technical permission, pilot interest, or brand consent is not enough.

evidenceStates.CONFIRMED_PUBLIC_TERMS: Explicit right is stated in current official public terms/docs.
evidenceStates.CONDITIONAL_PLAN: Right exists only if the identified commercial/business plan/license is active and applicable.
evidenceStates.LIMITED_SCOPE: Confirmed only for the exact described use/markets/fields/context.
evidenceStates.PENDING: Discussion or approval workflow exists, but permission is not yet granted.
evidenceStates.RESTRICTED: Evidence expressly restricts or excludes the right.
evidenceStates.NOT_APPLICABLE: Dimension does not materially apply to the provider/service or relationship being classified.

relationshipRule: Do not label a permission, exploratory exchange, pilot, design-partner conversation, co-marketing discussion, or proposed framework as a formal partnership unless mutual acceptance/execution of the relationship itself is evidenced.

runtimeActivationRule.reason: C14-P23 evidence classification is not a substitute for the existing legal-review, document-hash, expiry, and operation-scope gates.
requiredBeforeProductionGrant: reviewed source document or agreement snapshot
legal review when required by existing gate
effective plan/license actually active where the permission is plan-dependent
runtimeActivationRule.existingManifestAtBase: config/pass22/provider-rights-evidence-manifest.json is empty; C14-P23 does not silently populate it with APPROVED records.

legalBoundary: Engineering evidence classification only; not legal advice and not a declaration that a provider contract is enforceable in a particular jurisdiction.
